Muskie describes the "Edmund S. Muskie Internship Program" as a professional exchange program supported by the United States Department of State. This program offers summer internship placements, career training, and financial support to Eurasian scholars and graduate students studying in the United States. It was established by the United States Congress in the 1992 fiscal year and was named under the Freedom Support Act of 1992. The program was later relaunched by Cultural Vistas in 2015.
